name: pty paths
command: id; ls -ld /dev /dev/pts /dev/ptmx /dev/tty /dev/pts/ptmx /bin/sh /proc; readlink /bin/sh; awk '$5=="/dev" || $5=="/dev/pts" {print}' /proc/self/mountinfo; cat /proc/sys/kernel/pty/nr /proc/sys/kernel/pty/max; cat /proc/tty/drivers

name: shell and tools
command: printf 'shell flags: %s\n' "$-"; tty; stty -a; command -v strace; command -v script; command -v setsid; command -v python; command -v unshare; ls -l /etc/profile /etc/shells /etc/securetty /etc/login.defs /lib/libutil* 2>/dev/null; test ! -e /tmp/dlink-phase6a && echo phase6a-absent

name: kernel config
command: if test -r /proc/config.gz; then zcat /proc/config.gz | grep -E 'CONFIG_(UNIX98_PTYS|DEVPTS|LEGACY_PTYS|DEVTMPFS)'; else echo no-proc-config; fi; grep -E 'devpts|proc|tmpfs' /proc/filesystems; ls -l /dev/pts

name: boot hook inventory
command: ls -ld /data; ls -la /data; cat /etc/inittab; cat /etc/rc.d/rcS; cat /usr/syscfg/sys.init_after.sh; ls -l /etc/rc.local /etc/hotplug* /etc/crontabs /var/spool/cron /etc/init.d/cron 2>/dev/null

name: network policy
command: ip -o -4 addr show; ip -o -6 addr show; iptables -S INPUT; iptables -S service_list; ip6tables -S INPUT; netstat -lnt; awk '$2=="/" || $2=="/data" || $2=="/tmp" {print}' /proc/mounts; df -k /data /tmp
